description.value: La Ruelle Bakery is a small-batch French Canadian artisan bakery tucked into a charming back alley in downtown Nelson, BC, specializing in organic sourdough breads, handmade pastries, and fresh sandwiches to go. The open-concept bakehouse lets customers watch bakers at work, using organic flours and seasonal locally sourced ingredients — continuing a tradition inherited from the predecessor bakery Au Soleil Levant. All sales are takeaway-only, making it a straightforward stop for a freshly baked loaf or a quick lunch on the road.

The OSM tags (indoor_seating=no, outdoor_seating=no, takeaway=only) align with the website's description of a takeaway-only operation.
